facts.text: I watched the first season of the Pokémon anime as a kid.
I still enjoy the newer seasons of the Pokémon anime as an adult.
I appreciate how the Pokémon franchise has grown with me over the years.
I like that the Pokémon franchise is not just churning out the same thing over and over again.
I love the idea of exploring my real-world surroundings while trying to catch Pokémon in Pokémon Go.
I remember playing the original Pokémon Snap on my Nintendo 64.
I am excited about the new Pokémon Snap game coming out soon.
I am looking forward to the upcoming Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl remakes.
I want to revisit the Sinnoh region with updated graphics and gameplay in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl.
I am excited to see what new Pokémon will be introduced in future games and anime seasons.
I find it exciting to discover and catch new creatures in Pokémon.
